caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The chair consists of a light brown frame with vertical posts topped by round finials, and three horizontal slats forming the backrest, each with a gently curved design. The seat is depicted as a woven material in a pale, beige or off-white color. The chair has two armrests, each supported by vertical posts, and two curved rockers at the base, connecting the four legs of the chair. There are additional horizontal supports connecting the legs near the seat and toward the bottom. The overall composition focuses solely on the chair, with no other objects present.
title: Shaker Mushroom Rocker
